belief_calibration_rebind.reason: the unchanged preregistered 2022 monotone-reliability procedure must be refit after causal model-code changes; stale code-bound maps may not be relabeled or copied
belief_calibration_rebind.fixed_method: 10 quantile bins, minimum 20 episodes per bin, minimum 200 episodes per playbook, Beta(1,1), weighted PAVA, directions pooled

revealed_evidence_role: diagnose selection bias, label mismatch and missing timing primitives only; it may not be reused as untouched confirmation

candidate_contract.unit: one unique executable frozen plan at one completed 1m action clock
candidate_contract.clock_population: every always-flat causal replay clock containing at least one phase-executable unique ENTER plan, independent of the live decision and risk approval
candidate_contract.playbook_evidence: equivalent hypotheses are retained as correlated evidence for one action identity; probabilities are never summed
candidate_contract.competing_plans: different entry, structural stop price or provenance, target, deadline, or direction remain separate candidates
candidate_contract.risk_review: hard-veto results are recorded for diagnosis; only label-valid and risk-valid rows may enter a deployable net-utility fit
candidate_contract.initial_plan: the first causal non-null plan observed for the representative setup_id; later plans are compared to it in original-risk units and may never rewrite it
candidate_contract.right_boundary: pending orders and positions unresolved at the registered interval end are right-censored, never assigned 0R

flat_actions.common_freeze: direction, original structural invalidation, primary causal liquidity target, original risk and deadline freeze at the candidate action clock

actions.rule: submit the frozen planned-entry limit for the immediately following completed 1m bar only

observe exactly one additional completed 1m bar; if the frozen thesis is not invalidated, expired, contract-changed or target-consumed and its setup remains executable, submit the original frozen limit for the following completed bar only
from the next bar through five completed bars, submit a limit improved by 0.25 original R against the thesis direction; retain the original stop, target and deadline

wait at most 15 completed bars for the current direction-aligned 1m trigger to be lost and then restored together with direction-aligned 5m reacceptance; submit the original frozen limit on the following completed bar only
take no exposure; deterministic utility is 0R

flat_actions.fill_rule: conservative OHLC: adverse stop is chargeable in an ambiguous entry bar and a same-bar favorable target is not credited
flat_actions.management_baseline: after fill, hold the original structural stop and primary target without discretionary protect/exit until stop, target, hard deadline or contract change

position_actions.unit: one causally open baseline shadow position at a five-minute-spaced action clock

actions.rule: keep the current frozen-policy stop and hold to primary target, hard deadline or contract change
when a later causally confirmed thesis-side structural level strictly tightens risk, apply that stop from the next bar and then hold; otherwise the action is unavailable
exit at the next bar open; causal remaining spread, slippage and commission are represented once in the separate position execution-cost term, and if no next bar exists the row is right-censored

position_actions.anchor_trajectory: market prices are replayed once on the enter_now baseline trajectory; the original-stop state plus each later causally confirmed tighter structural-stop state is sampled only while that state could have survived after activation; no arbitrary policy-combination branches are generated, and all rows from the same candidate remain one correlated trajectory cluster
position_actions.runtime_clock: position Q is evaluated at the same five-minute-spaced clocks beginning with the first completed bar after fill; intervening 1m clocks issue no new management instruction and remain under hard stop, target, deadline and anomaly controls

features.direction_normalization: signed observations are multiplied by thesis direction sign; positive values support the candidate direction

registered_primitives.swing_trigger_consistency: minimum of direction-aligned 1H swing progression, 1m path sequence and 1m trigger hold after mapping each from [-1,1] to [0,1]
registered_primitives.first_pullback_quality: geometric mean of bounded pullback-depth quality, pullback completeness, direction-aligned reacceptance and inverse compression/counter-pressure penalty
registered_primitives.true_remaining_path_R: directional primary target distance from current price divided by original frozen risk; it is feature-time causal and is not replaced by realized MFE

forbidden: future bars, realized fills, MFE, MAE, terminal outcome or later plan fields
feature or threshold selection using validation PnL
using a constant spread or fillability value as MBO execution reality
features.missing_execution_encoding: when source is not mbo_reconstructed, spread, expected-cost, fillability and depth values are encoded as neutral 0 with mbo_available=0 and stale-age=1; observer fallbacks remain risk-veto diagnostics and cannot enter the model as pseudo-MBO measurements

label_decomposition.fill: binary causal fill before action expiry
label_decomposition.conditional_gross_R: baseline-management terminal gross R conditional on fill
label_decomposition.cost_R: decision-time causal expected round-trip spread, slippage and commission divided by frozen original risk; missing MBO remains missing
label_decomposition.flat_expected_utility: P(fill) * (E[conditional gross R | fill] - E[cost R | fill]) + P(no fill) * 0
label_decomposition.position_labels: hold, protect and exit terminal gross utility from the same position action clock plus a separately recorded causal remaining one-side execution-cost term; never mixed into the flat-entry outcome model

models.fill: one fixed L2 logistic regression per non-abstain flat action
models.conditional_gross_mean: one fixed L2 ridge regression per non-abstain flat action
models.conditional_execution_cost: one fixed L2 ridge regression per non-abstain flat action on causally observed MBO cost conditional on fill; immediate/resting-now actions use current observed MBO cost at inference, while delayed wait actions use this frozen estimate of their later submission-clock cost
models.conditional_loss_probability: one fixed L2 logistic regression per non-abstain flat action
models.conditional_downside_bound: gross mean plus the training residual 10th percentile
models.incremental_action_value: separate fixed L2 ridge models on paired same-clock gross and MBO-net action-label differences; gross models use every structurally valid mature label, net models and their OOF mapping use only action clocks with causal mbo_available=1 so double-unfilled non-MBO 0R pairs cannot impersonate execution evidence; structural validation uses the gross family and deployable/runtime entry requires both gross and net direct deltas
models.position_action_value: separate fixed L2 ridge by registered position action family

fit.flat_action_parameter_sharing: the same feature order and regularization are frozen for every action, but coefficients are action-specific because enter, passive wait and reacceptance wait have different fill and outcome mechanisms; abstain remains deterministic and has no fitted model
fit.standardization: fit on each training fold only
fit.runtime_semantics_binding: the fitted artifact hashes the complete v2.3 engine config after removing only the descriptive version and artifact-path fields; changing reader, brain, decision, risk or protocol settings makes the artifact unavailable

inference.decomposed_action_Q: predicted fill probability multiplied by predicted conditional gross mean minus predicted fill probability multiplied by causal conditional execution cost; enter_now and wait_better_price use current observed MBO cost because their orders begin now, wait_one_bar and wait_reacceptance use the frozen conditional-cost model because their order clocks are later, and abstain is exactly 0R
inference.direct_delta_use: enter may outrank a wait action only when decomposed net Q(enter)-Q(wait), direct gross delta and direct MBO-net delta are all strictly positive; disagreement or missing execution authority is fail-closed
inference.downside_use: conditional loss probability and the residual 10th-percentile bound are displayed and audited; they do not receive a PnL-selected weight
inference.missing_MBO: gross structural value may be audited, but net entry is unavailable and risk must abstain
inference.structural_positive_enter_bucket: decomposed gross enter Q is positive and exceeds abstain and every wait gross Q, every direct enter-minus-wait gross prediction is positive, downside bound is above -1R and the structural plan is valid
inference.deployable_positive_enter_bucket: the structural positive-enter definition holds, current causal MBO net Q is positive and exceeds every alternative, and every current hard execution gate passes
inference.historical_non_MBO_cost_stress: for cross-year validation only, subtract the frozen risk-engine maximum 0.20R from each filled structural action and 0R from an unfilled action; this is a conservative stress label, never represented as observed execution reality or used at runtime

release_gates.label_and_causality_audit: must pass before any profitability test
release_gates.gross_incremental_delta_mapping: each registered enter-minus-alternative gross model must have strictly positive temporal-OOF Spearman mapping on at least 500 paired candidate clocks
release_gates.mbo_net_incremental_delta_mapping: each registered enter-minus-alternative net model must have strictly positive temporal-OOF Spearman mapping on at least 50 causally cost-labeled candidate clocks
release_gates.positive_bucket_net_mean_R_both_directio: strictly positive with at least 100 actions each
release_gates.positive_bucket_net_mean_R_each_register: strictly positive with at least 100 actions each
release_gates.gross_to_mbo_net: June fit / July validation degradation must remain net positive; sealed August-December is revealed only after every prior gate passes
release_gates.cross_year_after_cost_definition: positive bucket must remain positive in every fold, calendar year, direction and registered regime under the preregistered 0.20R filled-action stress; revealed July must separately remain positive under actual causal MBO cost
release_gates.cost_stress: 1.5x observed cost must remain net positive
release_gates.position_action_mapping: hold, protect and exit must each have positive temporal-OOF rank mapping with at least 100 resolved actions
release_gates.position_management_increment: using the frozen 0.12R action-advantage floor, non-hold position choices must improve realized gross utility versus same-clock hold in every OOF fold and both directions, and the weekly-cluster 95% lower bound must be positive
release_gates.minimum_action_advantage: frozen before v2.3 sample generation at 0.12R from the existing decision contract; it is not searched or selected from validation PnL
release_gates.failure_behavior: artifact status unavailable; enter/protect cannot outrank abstain/hold

engineering.checkpoint: hash-bound atomic manifest plus trusted local serialized causal replay, initial-plan registry and unresolved shadow actions
engineering.resume: exact source-row continuation with shard hash and row conservation checks; an interruption during a partially processed bar falls back to the prior durable checkpoint rather than serializing partial state
engineering.progress: processed source rows, completed percent, throughput, ETA, candidate/action/resolution counts
engineering.episode_join: temporary disk-backed exact-key indexes plus bounded Parquet output; outcomes and paired deltas are never concatenated across the full calibration interval
